requirements.description: Generated grass, earth and bank transitions have coherent clustered pixel treatment alongside existing generated cottage/tree sprites, materially closer to original user reference than procedural ground. Inspect dominant repetition and worst material join.

Shared source crops reconstruct without seams; generated channel follows authoritative water/land boundary, dry-looking ground remains usable and both bridge approaches work. Report source warp and residual drift honestly; no silent navigation changes.
If using generated water, full surface travels continuously within stationary banks with no grass scrolling in channel; inspect complete loop and exact pause on both viewports.

comparisons.focus: Ground material clusters, natural path/grass/bank integration, coherent object/ground appearance. Original village layout, not a forest layout copy.
